purpose: E64 原权数附注锚结构补充；保留最初0锚、原绑定、模型登记与输入，无新拟合
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,re,hashlib,unicodedata
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
ROOT=Path.cwd();R='reports/research/510300_employment_delivery_cause_increment_v1';OUT=ROOT/R
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def save(n,o):
 p=OUT/n;assert not p.exists(),'旧输出保持：'+n
 p.write_text(json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
a=json.loads((OUT/'全部132月就业配送原文绑定.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
before=sha(OUT/'全部132月就业配送原文绑定.json')
save('原权数方法锚_词项结构补正登记.json',{'registered_at':now(),'original_binding_sha256':before,'original_anchor_count':0,'reason':'实际官方附注使用权数，不用权重。首程序只匹配权重所以方法锚为0；两固定问项原数、132原页、源钟、全1711支持与模型登记不变。以实际权数原词保存方法补充，旧0锚及原绑定不覆盖。','supplement_only':True,'new_source_requests':0,'new_model_fits':0,'new_labels':0,'source_code_edits':0})
rows=[]
for z in a:
 p=ROOT/z['raw_path'];assert sha(p)==z['raw_sha256']
 t=re.sub(r'\s+','',unicodedata.normalize('NFKC',BeautifulSoup(p.read_bytes(),'html.parser').get_text(' ')))
 candidates=[t[max(0,m.start()-180):m.start()+500] for m in re.finditer('权数|权重',t)]
 anchors=[s for s in candidates if all(k in s for k in ['30%','25%','20%','15%','10%']) and ('逆指数' in s or '反向运算' in s)]
 rows.append({'stat_month':z['stat_month'],'source_url':z['source_url'],'raw_path':z['raw_path'],'raw_sha256':z['raw_sha256'],'status':'ORIGINAL_FIXED_WEIGHTS_AND_REVERSE_METHOD_ANCHORED' if anchors else 'UNKNOWN_METHOD_ANCHOR','actual_official_method_anchor':anchors[:1],'original_two_field_values_unchanged':True})
save('全部132月原权数与反向配送方法_补充原锚.json',rows)
count=sum(bool(z['actual_official_method_anchor']) for z in rows)
save('原方法锚结构补正回执.json',{'completed_at':now(),'actual_method_anchor_months':count,'monthly_originals':132,'source_binding_kept_identical':sha(OUT/'全部132月就业配送原文绑定.json')==before,'initial_0_anchor_preserved':True,'new_fits':0,'new_labels':0,'new_network_requests':0,'model_inputs_unchanged':True,'stock_return_cause_identified':False})
report=OUT/'就业配送_原来源与不同用途.md';old=report.read_bytes();s=old.decode('utf-8')
s+='\n原方法锚接续：初次程序仅匹配“权重”，实际附注使用“权数”，因此初次0锚不是官方没有方法。按实际原词另存补充锚，'+str(count)+'/132月原方法确认；原0锚、原绑定、两固定原值、源钟与模型输入哈希保持。[方法补充](全部132月原权数与反向配送方法_补充原锚.json)、[结构补正回执](原方法锚结构补正回执.json)。\n'
assert report.read_bytes()==old;report.write_text(s,encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'原方法锚补充':count,'固定两字段源与模型登记保持':True,'新拟合/标签/请求':0},ensure_ascii=False))
